summary.text: Travis Couture is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 35-Position 2 since January 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Maria Littlesun.

paragraphs.text: Travis Couture was born in Sidney, Montana, and lives in Allyn, Washington.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 2007 to 2011, earned a bachelor's degree in organizational leadership from Brandman University in 2019 and an M.B.A. from Brandman University in 2020.
His career experience includes working as a defense contractor at Naval Submarine Base Kitsap.
